emi.tree_tabs.fork.desc: Opens a second copy you can resolve differently
emi.tree_tabs.hint.select: Left click to switch, drag to reorder
emi.tree_tabs.hint.rename: Right click or F2 to rename
emi.tree_tabs.hint.close: Middle click or Ctrl+W to close
emi.tree_tabs.hint.crafting: Ctrl+click to switch between viewing and crafting
emi.tree_tabs.config.title: EMI Tree Tabs
emi.tree_tabs.config.enabled.tooltip: Off means no tab bar and stock EMI behaviour.
emi.tree_tabs.config.openInNewTab: Open trees in a new tab
emi.tree_tabs.config.openInNewTab.toolti: Hold Shift while opening a tree to invert this for one click.
emi.tree_tabs.config.keyboardShortcuts.t: Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+W, Ctrl+D, Ctrl+1-9 and F2 on the tree screen.
emi.tree_tabs.config.maxTabs.tooltip: Each open tab holds a whole material graph, so this is the main lever on memory use.
emi.tree_tabs.config.closedTabHistory.to: How many closed tabs Ctrl+Shift+T can bring back. Zero disables it.
emi.tree_tabs.config.barAtBottom.tooltip: Moves the strip to the bottom, where it covers EMI's help button.
emi.tree_tabs.config.showProgress.toolti: Colour each tab by how much of its tree you already have.
How often to recheck every tab against your inventory. Higher is cheaper.
emi.tree_tabs.config.aggregateCraftingFa: Crafting mode pulls from all tracked trees, not just the visible one. Ctrl+click a tab to leave it out.
emi.tree_tabs.config.sharedCraftingInven: Trees claim materials in tab order instead of each assuming the whole inventory. Off double-counts anything two trees both need.
emi.tree_tabs.config.craftingPanelSide.t: Which sidebar shows the crafting list instead of favourites. Set that sidebar to Favourites in EMI's settings first. NONE keeps one panel.
emi.tree_tabs.config.groupCraftingList.t: Split into shared materials and one section per tree.
emi.tree_tabs.config.showGroupSeparators: Draw a rule between sections. Costs a row of slots per divider.
emi.tree_tabs.config.collapsibleGroups.t: Click a section title to fold it away.
emi.tree_tabs.config.markChoiceEntries.t: Frame a crafting-list entry that accepts any of several items, so a tag is not mistaken for the plain item next to it.
emi.sidebar.type.tree_tabs_crafting.desc: What your tracked recipe trees still need
emi.tree_tabs.config.craftingInFavorites: Off keeps the favourites sidebar strictly favourites. Ignored once a Crafting page is placed on a sidebar, since it would otherwise show twice.
emi.tree_tabs.all.title: Craft every tab
emi.tree_tabs.all.hint: Click or Ctrl+A. Ctrl+click a recipe's tree button to open it already crafting.
emi.tree_tabs.group.parked: Set aside — not asking for materials
emi.tree_tabs.batch.title: How many?
emi.tree_tabs.attribution.title: Wanted by
emi.tree_tabs.attribution.hint: Hold Shift for the sub-craft split
emi.tree_tabs.attribution.subcraft.title: Goes into
emi.tree_tabs.sync.title: Recipe applied everywhere
emi.tree_tabs.sync.offer.title: %s other tree(s) use this
emi.tree_tabs.sync.offer.body: Ctrl+Shift+S for all of them, or Shift+click a highlighted tab
emi.tree_tabs.sync.candidate: Uses a different recipe for your last choice
emi.tree_tabs.sync.candidate.hint: Shift+click to apply it here only
emi.tree_tabs.config.category.layout.too: Where the tabs are and what they look like.
emi.tree_tabs.config.category.crafting.t: What the sidebar gathers from your trees, and how it is sectioned.
What opening, closing and keyboard shortcuts do.
emi.tree_tabs.config.group.advanced.desc: Touches how tabs are stored, or how often work is done. Safe to leave alone — a wrong answer here costs you tabs rather than looks.
emi.tree_tabs.config.preview.text: A live tab bar, drawn by the same layout code the game uses. Change the setting and this changes with it.
emi.tree_tabs.config.preview.density.ico: Icons only — %spx a tab, then it scrolls
emi.tree_tabs.config.preview.sidebar: Floating sidebar — room for names at any GUI scale
emi.tree_tabs.config.offerResolutionSync: Offer to sync a recipe choice
When you pick a recipe for an ingredient, say how many other open trees still use a different one, and offer to change them.
